resources.string: Optional unverified Instagram diagnostic. With fresh report consent, Doom traverses only an Instagram accessibility root and keeps one bounded report containing sanitized static Instagram resource names, normalized safe classes, depth, capped child count, and interaction booleans. The report admits at most 64 unique resource/class tokens and 8,192 ASCII characters/UTF-8 bytes. It never keeps UI text, descriptions, notification content, account data, screenshots, raw trees, bounds, or node/window IDs. Doom receives package identifiers for window events from all apps only to detect leaving Instagram; it returns before reading a foreign active root. A separate default-off consent may show a five-second accessibility overlay after a strong first Feed, Reels, or Stories prediction. Messaging, unknown, mixed, truncated, missing-root, foreign-window, error, revocation, interruption, and disconnect paths fail open and remove the overlay. Dismiss performs no Instagram action. Leave removes the overlay before system Home. No report files, logs, network, automatic export, Instagram node actions, or protection guarantee. Reviewed clipboard copy leaves Doom memory and cannot be recalled. Turn off either consent at any time.
